SKYD.headline: Stock Market Today, Oct. 14: Skydance Warrants Begin Separate Trading Today: SKYD Stock Drops 24%
SKYD.description: Skydance (SKYD) stock fell 24% on October 14, 2026, after 471 million warrants began trading separately from the company's shares on the ex-distribution date. The warrants, issued to former Paramount shareholders, allow them to purchase SKYD shares at $12 each through 2036. If fully exercised, this would generate $5.7 billion but dilute shares by roughly 10%. SKYD.headline: Why Skydance Stock Fell 28.5% Today
SKYD.description: Skydance stock dropped 28.5% on Wednesday due to a warrant dividend distribution to Class B shareholders. Each shareholder received one warrant per share, exercisable at $12 per share for 10 years. The warrants trade separately and are valued at approximately $1.1 billion. This restructuring did not represent actual value loss for eligible shareholders, as the warrant value offsets the stock price decline. The Ellison family and RedBird Capital were excluded from the warrant distribution.
